Name: CUTSCENE_MAP_ID_PARAM_ST
Description: Map settings of a cutscene: the map it plays in, the maps a guest needs loaded to play it, and its fade, skip and mission-retry behaviour.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Playback Map ID
Fields.Description: Map the cutscene plays in, as an 8-digit map ID. This is the map the cutscene's positions are based on; a wrong map shifts the playback position.

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [1]
Fields.Description: Map needed to show the cutscene, as an 8-digit map ID. A guest uses this list to decide whether it can play the cutscene. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [2]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [3]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [4]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [5]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [6]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Display Requirement: Map ID [7]
Fields.Description: As Display Requirement: Map ID [1].

Fields.Name: Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: 8-digit cutscene ID. Filled in automatically.

Fields.Name: Replay on Mission Retry
Fields.Description: Whether this opening cutscene plays again when the mission is retried. Set it on cutscenes that should not replay on retry.

Fields.Name: Player State after Cutscene Skip
Fields.Description: State the player starts in after the cutscene is skipped. Default: no change.

Fields.Name: Player State after Cutscene Play
Fields.Description: State the player starts in after the cutscene has played. The default is idle.

Fields.Name: White Fade-out into Cutscene
Fields.Description: If ON, the fade-out from gameplay into the cutscene is to white instead of black.

Fields.Name: Wait for Map Load after Skip
Fields.Description: If ON, skipping shows the Now Loading screen and waits for the map to load. Mainly for catapult cutscenes.

Fields.Name: Played Back to Back in Event
Fields.Description: Set on cutscenes an event plays back to back, so the HUD does not flash up for a moment between them.

Fields.Name: Reset Auto-Exposure on Skip
Fields.Description: If ON, auto-exposure is reset when the cutscene is skipped (stops the screen turning white after a skip).

Fields.Name: Clear In-game Decals
Fields.Description: If ON, in-game decals are removed so the cutscene's own decals take priority and are shown.

Fields.Name: Fade-out Time into Cutscene
Fields.Description: Fade-out time from gameplay into the cutscene. In seconds. -1: system default.

Fields.Name: Fade-in Time back to Gameplay
Fields.Description: Fade-in time from the cutscene back to gameplay. In seconds. -1: system default.
